description: Free NPI lookup in the CMS NPPES registry (refreshed daily). Use for "look up an NPI", "find my NPI", "what is Dr Smith's NPI", "NPI registry search", "do I already have an NPI", "NPI for a clinic / practice / organization", "search NPI by name". Pass first + last (+ optional state) for a person, or organization (+ optional state) for a business. Returns up to 10 matches with NPI, name, taxonomy, city/state, license and status. No login or key needed.

first.description: First name (2+ letters; a trailing * matches the rest).

organization.description: Business / practice / organization name for an NPI-2 search (also matches DBA names). Use instead of first + last.

state.description: Two-letter US state to narrow results, e.g. UT. Optional.

name: lookup_npi
title: Look up an NPI by name or business name
